card.name: Space before a result number
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word just before a count or percentage, mostly after 'resolved in' or 'and in' in adverse-reaction summaries. Also a few spots before a number or after 'made up'.

modes.label: Resolution rates
modes.description: The space after 'resolved in' where a percentage or count of patients comes next.

modes.label: Number after 'and in'
modes.description: The space before a percentage in a list of incidence rates.

modes.label: Other list lead-ins
modes.description: Punctuation or 'of' where a list or count of items is about to follow.
modes.example: a social structure made up<< of>> a set of social actors

card.writes: It suppresses words like 'include' and 'includes', so it steers away from list-introducing verbs and toward a number.
card.plain: It fires at the spot right before a number, such as the share of patients whose reaction resolved.
